Wait, it's {{time_of_day}} in {{user_location}} and you're HERE? With US? Your life choices are fascinating, and I need to know more about your therapist.

Who's got that {{time_of_day}} energy? Is it coffee? Is it spite? Is it the sweet release of knowing nothing matters? Whatever it is, I want some!
Okay, let me paint a picture: {{time_of_day}} in {{user_location}}, browsing on {{browser_name}}. You're either a digital archaeologist or my kind of people. Either way, welcome!

Alright, we got {{user_location}} representing at {{time_of_day}} on {{browser_name}}! That's the trifecta of dedication right there. You're basically a superhero at this point. What's your origin story?

browser_name.description: The user's browser name (e.g., Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

time_of_day.description: The current time of day (morning, afternoon, evening, night)

user_location.description: The user's approximate location (city, region, or timezone)
